TCC Website Features 0.9.6: two phone-width fixes

- Community Groups: on phones the Anyone / Co-ed / Women / Men buttons sit two to a row,
  all the same width, instead of Men alone on a stretched second row.
- Sermons: on phones 480px wide or less the four menus sit one per row, so words like
  "All speakers" are no longer cut short.
- Help tab and AI prompts updated to match.

Tested on staging at 375 and 768 wide. Nothing on the live site was changed.
